messages:
Ivy (PM): Proposal: fast-fallback and tenant guardrails for the new routing override. Need clear automatic actions + CS visibility.
Dex (Eng): Plan: global flag + per-tenant override + runtime guard that can flip to legacy router in <500ms.
Sam (SRE): Safety rules: per-tenant rolling-error threshold (0.8% over 5m) -> immediate quarantine; infra cap: at most 1.5x baseline QPS shift in first 12h.
Priya (CS): CS needs webhook when a tenant is quarantined, and a one-click undo in console. Also audit log of manual pins.
Dex (Eng): Will add quarantine TTL (15m) and manual-unpin endpoint. Also add EWMA-based noise filter so tiny tenants don't oscillate.
Ivy (PM): Rollout stages: internal smoke (2 hosts) -> 2% tenant seed -> 15% regional -> 100% over 7d. Each stage needs monitor windows: smoke 1h, seed 24h, regional 48h.
Sam (SRE): Alerting: quarantine-event -> page SRE on pager for premium tenants; infra-cap-breach -> page infra owner. Include deploy-bot messages when stage changes.
flag-bot: routing_override created in staging by Dex at 2141705590 :white_check_mark:
Ivy (PM): Decision: proceed with plan. Dex -> API + EWMA gate. Sam -> infra caps + alerts. Priya -> webhook schema. Sync tomorrow 11:00 for runbook sign-off.
